evidence.decision: Assigns row selection to navigation, option choice or editing and chooses comparisons/columns versus visual collections; preserves full expected Watch data.
evidence.artifact: Delivers a row artifact with explicit selection, editing and sorting behavior contracts.
evidence.transformation: Watch subscriptions show relevant feeds first plus access to all subscribed content instead of permanently dropping all but five.
evidence.verification: Checks empty/long lists, identifier truncation, reversed sorting, selected deletion and all-items access; fails incorrect detail identity and lost items.
evidence.applicability: Scopes iOS edit/index behavior, Mac resizing/sorting, TV focus space and Watch detail-scroll limitations.
evidence.handoffs: Hands image-led browsing to Collections and Mac hierarchical attributes to Outline views.
evidence.distinctiveness: Persistent path versus option checkmarks, full-dataset access and row-operation semantics make this a list/table procedure.
